head: claude/rq-ops-2-dispatcher-fix
title: RQ-OPS-2: root-cause + fix research-queue-dispatch.yml cancellations, add liveness alarm
body:
## Summary

Tier-1 (GitHub Actions workflow + CI tooling + docs only; nothing on the live VM, no order path, no config). Root-causes and fixes the `research-queue-dispatch.yml` cancellations from row `RQ-OPS` on `MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json`.

**Root cause** (both runs that actually cancelled, 36239222079 & 35996108860): the stamp PR's required `pytest-run` took ~13m GitHub queue time + ~20m run time (~33m total) -- already past `commit-to-main`'s 30m `verify-merged` deadline before the outer 35m job timeout killed the wait mid-poll, reporting an ambiguous `cancelled` instead of a clear pass/fail. A separate, already-fixed bug (`73a25dd0d`, landed 2026-09-26T17:24Z) had the stamp diff invalidate its own required test on two branches (#12989, #13012) cut minutes/hours before that fix landed -- now superseded, since their stamps landed via later runs.

**Fix**: `timeout-minutes` 35 -> 70, sized for two sequential `commit-to-main` `verify-merged` waits (a liveness receipt step was added ahead of the stamp step, `verify-merged: true` on both per `tests/test_commit_to_main_callers.py`'s no-exemption rule).

**Added**: a committed liveness receipt + `scripts/ci/check_research_queue_dispatch_liveness.py` (self-test plants a stale receipt and a fresh quiet control), registered in `run_guards.py`, wired to dispatch `send-ping` via the `system-actions` workflow when stale (no successful run in 48h, or never committed a receipt).

**Documented** (`research/queue/README.md`): the declared-vs-actually-dispatchable `run.workflow` split -- 13 of 19 committed units name a real `*.yml` target; 6 (4 issue-label-relay, 2 none/session-local) grade identically to a real workflow-routed unit but would fail at the `gh workflow run` call on a real fire. Filed as `PI-20260928-RQOPS2-0002`.

**Filed** `PI-20260928-RQOPS2-0001`: this session's GitHub MCP token 403s (`Resource not accessible by integration`) on `update_pull_request` / `add_issue_comment` / `create_pull_request`, so PRs #12989 and #13012 could not be closed here despite being superseded, and this PR itself was opened through pr-opener.yml rather than the MCP -- contradicts `docs/reference/session-capabilities.md`, which is itself flagged "never verified, do not act on as current."

Part of `RQ-OPS-2` (session_01G2SwTpGGacwEKLHukpTp3w), dispatched by the manager (session_01KAQRJxRbRwpYTkPgBjNVyQ). Authorized directly by the operator via a confirmation dialog after the prior lane (session_01NceHayuAx2a9H58Vx8j8TX, archived) halted pending that confirmation.

## Test plan

- [x] `pytest tests/test_commit_to_main_callers.py tests/test_research_queue.py tests/test_guard_selftest_coverage.py` -- 136 passed
- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/check_research_queue_dispatch_liveness.py --self-test` -- plants never_ran/stale/fresh/boundary/unreadable, all graded correctly
- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py --base origin/main` -- OK, `state=declared_self_land`
- [ ] Manual `workflow_dispatch fire=true only=<cheap unit>` proof-of-life (next, will report run IDs)
- [ ] Next scheduled `research-queue-dispatch` run completes success/failure (never `cancelled`)
